about.title: About

about.p2: From low-level C projects to modern web apps with React and Next.js, I enjoy exploring the full spectrum of development and building clean, efficient applications.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for Jean-Jacques Delegue's portfolio — personal data collection and processing in accordance with GDPR.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introContent: This website is a personal, non-commercial portfolio. This policy describes the personal data that may be collected during your visit and how it is processed, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.collectionContent: The only personal data collected is what you voluntarily provide through the contact form: name, email address, and message content. This data is only collected with your explicit consent when submitting the form.
privacy.purposeContent: Contact form data is used solely to reply to your message. It is neither sold nor shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.thirdPartyContent: The contact form uses the Web3Forms service (web3forms.com) to route messages. Data entered in the form is transmitted to this service. Web3Forms is subject to its own privacy policy, available on their website.
privacy.analyticsContent: This website uses Vercel Analytics to measure traffic in an aggregated and anonymized manner. No tracking cookies are placed on your device. The data collected does not allow personal identification.
privacy.retentionContent: Contact form data is retained only for as long as necessary to process your request, then deleted. Web3Forms applies its own retention rules.
privacy.rightsContent: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, and port your data, as well as the right to object to its processing. To exercise these rights, contact: jean-jacques.delegue@epitech.eu.
privacy.contactContent: For any questions regarding the processing of your personal data: jean-jacques.delegue@epitech.eu
